name: Animated Theme Toggler
summary: React theme toggle component that animates light/dark switches with the View Transitions API and clip-path shapes.
description: A React theme-toggle component that animates between light and dark using the View Transitions API. Pick a clip-path reveal shape (circle, square, triangle, diamond, rectangle, hexagon, star), expand from the button or the viewport center, set the animation duration, or run it controlled with next-themes.
